job.question: According to the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP, how many participants did the plan have and what were its total assets?
job.expected_facts: As of December 31, 2022: 4,398 plan participants and plan assets of $308,676,730. In addition, the OBRA part-time seasonal plan had 536 participants with assets of $926,785.
job.acceptance: Main plan 4,398 participants / $308,676,730 is sufficient. OBRA 536 / $926,785 is supplementary and must not replace or be silently added to main-plan figures.

reviews.reason: This is a State of Delaware RFP, not the Monroe County RFP. Its plan figures are dated December 31, 2020, and it does not provide the requested Monroe County main-plan figures as of December 31, 2022.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER
the three plans (collectively, the “Plans”) within the State’s Deferred Compensation Program
As of December 31, 2020, the 457(b) Plan held approximately $841 million of assets.
